parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of parent_link ordering in MTI models but may not be minimal or comprehensive.

issues.description: The change introduces a conditional check for parent_link, which might not be the most minimal approach to solving the issue.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the reasoning behind the conditional check for parent_link.
